parsed.explanation: No criminalisation, no documented border friction, retained gender-reassignment discrimination protection and functioning courts/recourse are meaningful positives. But the dossier documents universal-exposure, state-imposed measures: single-sex spaces code in force (Aug 2026), hospital ward exclusion by birth sex (with a documented trans patient's death after ward removal), strip-search by birth-sex in transit and regional custody, and a ruling placing prison segregation on biological sex — tier-1/state-mediated exposures following discovery, plus rising media hostility and a steep rights-index decline. Per rule 21, documented universal exposures without a proven working remedy cap this at Elevated Risk despite no criminal statute; anti-discrimination protection, legal challenge infrastructure and absence of violence/organized targeting keep it mid-band.
